mission.title: Terminate
mission.description: Hunt down the Zion veterans whose captured RSI signatures still turn up in the simulation.

npc.say: No! Rickie, Genevieve... Get out of here!
I don't know... Maybe another fifteen minutes, if you guys stop arguing and help out.

phase.briefing:
{player}, although most of Zion's veteran operatives whose RSI signatures we captured have left the Matrix, some of these signatures are still being detected occasionally within the simulation. Their continued presence defies logic; possibly Zion underestimates our ability to pinpoint and execute them.
I have a number of these targets for you to find and eliminate today. The first holds high rank in Zion's recruiting program; the desperate straits in which their recruiting efforts have been placed by our recent successes may be responsible for her risking her life by remaining.

enter.say: Okay, Ponomarev is in there. I'm seeing a few other redpill signals--probably other Zionites--and a couple bluepills. Better be careful you don't wing the blues.

done.say: Hey, don't waste time on the others. We've got real targets to take care of.

phase.briefing:
The deadly efficiency of your attacks appears to be putting Zion increasingly on the alert. They know now that they cannot flaunt System protocols.
Continue to your next target, {player}.

enter.say:
Okay. Dalasi is supposed to be a tough fighter so-- Whoopsie.
Ehm... I just lost their signal. I've got other redpills in there, but not the one we had locked. Maybe they've found a way to cloak the signal, or something.

done.say: Hm... No... This isn't looking promising. Must'a snuck out to a hardline, I guess.

Ooh, anger. "Roland" sounds familiar... I think he was some old hard-ass Zion captain.
Oh! Now I remember where I heard the name--he's the guy who got promoted to Commander, since Lock's been missing ever since Zion got sacked.
Don't remember hearing about this "Colt," though. Some nubcake, most likely.

complete.say: Yeah, Dalasi definitely isn't there anymore. We'd better just skip it and check back in with Gray.

phase.briefing:
Unfortunate, but not unexpected.
Even if the operatives do escape, they will have to wait until their RSI signature can be reconfigured in order to be able to enter the Matrix without fear of immediate deletion. We project that it will take Zion at least several weeks to reconfigure a significant number of their veteran operatives, during which time their efforts in the Matrix will be at a near standstill, particularly as the RSI signatures of their senior field commanders, Niobe and Ghost, are among those captured from the Zion mainframe.
Your next target is located at one of the "extraction point" facilities Zion uses to assist in removal of newly recruited terrorists from the simulation.

enter.say: I've got Chant's signal in there, and a few other redpills. No bluepills, though. I wonder why the operatives are hanging around the extraction point? Oh well, their loss.

done.say: No. I told you, they're watching those. We just rig this thing up, and I can get out with no risk. How much longer to switch it over?
I don't know... Maybe another fifteen minutes, if you guys stop arguing and help out.
I think I'm gonna need you to hurry it the hell up!

complete.say: Good. Your next target can be found at the indicated location. It is not clear why they have remained in the simulation.
Disregard the last orders, operative. Stand down. Do not pursue the target.
I repeat: stand down, {player}. Disengage and leave the area immediately.

mission.finish:
Thank you, operative. Your ability to obey orders is exemplary.
That will be all at this time.
